requirements.rule: Art. 201: the guarantee of the commission-paid staff. The una tantum of Art. 197 (July 2024 and 2025) is historic and outside the TFR base (c. 6).
requirements.remediation: Model the guarantee of commission-paid staff.
Model the pay of the Art. 70 contract.

requirements.rule: SICKNESS (Art. 170): the CCNL integrates up to a share of the net daily pay ('retribuzione giornaliera netta') without saying how the net pay is computed. The engine grosses up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate and tops it up to the measure of the gross daily quota, as for the Commercio file. The exempt events of c. 3 are an input (SicknessEpisode.short_absence_exempt, read with carenza_by_event) (review of 2026-10-30).
requirements.remediation: Model the net daily pay of Art. 170.
